# Breathizen

> Breathizen (label spelling BreathiZen) is a dietary supplement sold as a herbal oral spray for airway comfort and easier breathing. This page at getbreathizen.vercel.app is an independent affiliate information page, not the manufacturer; orders are completed on the official Breathizen website. Checked 2026-11-11.

## The product in one block

- Format: liquid oral spray, amber glass bottle with a pump top
- Serving: 4 pumps, about 0.60 mL, once a day, ideally in the morning before the first meal; shake before use
- One bottle: 30 days
- Active ingredients: mullein leaf extract (10:1), ginger root extract, bromelain, organic lemon extract, organic Cordyceps militaris fruiting body extract
- Milligram amounts per serving are not published, and no clinical trial of the finished spray has been published
- Manufacturer states it is made in the United States in an FDA-registered facility
- Regulated as a dietary supplement, not a medicine; it does not replace an inhaler or any prescribed treatment

## The 60-day calendar

- Day 1: first serving; the refund clock starts on the purchase date
- Days 2 to 7: build the habit; no fast-acting ingredient is present
- Weeks 2 to 4: track morning congestion, throat clearing and stairs
- Day 30: first bottle finished; review before buying more
- Day 60: refund window closes; the manufacturer asks for at least 30 days of use before a claim

Single payment, no subscription or automatic renewal. 60-day money-back guarantee from the purchase date, claimed by email to the manufacturer's support team.

## Cautions

Ask a doctor first if you take anticoagulant or antiplatelet medication, blood pressure or diabetes medication, have surgery scheduled, or live with asthma or COPD. Not suitable for anyone allergic to pineapple (bromelain) or to fungi (cordyceps). Adults 18 and over only, and not for anyone pregnant or nursing. Sudden breathlessness, wheezing, chest pain, blood in a cough, or a cough lasting over three weeks need medical care, not a supplement.
